info.name: Songstats API
info.description:
Enterprise Access to Music Data across all DSPs

Enterprise API collection generated from docs/songstats_api_openapi.yaml and live Rails Enterprise routes.
Set the `api_key` collection variable before sending authenticated requests. The collection uses the `apikey` header for authentication. Link and track mutations require the matching `add_link_request`, `remove_link_request`, `add_track_request`, or `remove_track_request` permission plus access to the requested object type.

Postman exports collections as JSON. This file uses the Postman Collection v2.1 schema.

Member key lifecycle: Member API keys have one current credential per member. Disabling or regenerating a member key also prevents legacy duplicate credentials from authorizing requests. Creating an MCP connection preserves an existing agreement's disabled state and administrator permissions. Temporarily disabled member keys can be enabled by explicit regeneration in Account settings; permanently disabled keys require support review. These rules do not combine separate Enterprise agreements or their accounting histories.

item.name: Add Artist To Member Relevant List

query.description: Songstats artist ID.

request.description:
Adds the selected artist to the calling member's source-object relevance list. Send each selector as a single value and only once across the query and request body. JSON bodies may be up to 32 KiB. Requires an enabled member API key and current Songstats or Radiostats access to the selected profile; ordinary Enterprise agreement keys receive 403. This operation does not create a subscription or grant analytics access. It is not available through the read-only MCP tools.

Adding an already active source object is idempotent; adding a previously removed object reactivates its existing row.
